# std/const

> Constant: const NAME = value

truck [std](../std.md) · [source](../../../registry/std/const.pkg) · translated by [bintables/const](../bintables/const.md) · translated by [ctables/const](../ctables/const.md) · translated by [webtables/const](../webtables/const.md)

```
const WIDTH = 80
const GREETING = "hello"

print WIDTH * 2
```

The value is copied to every use, so it must not depend on variables or
function calls; it may use other constants and literals. Constants are
top-level declarations and can be used before they are declared.

## Syntax
